body: I'll take a look and see if I can reproduce.

This is expected behavior. The default Route class does not apply any inflection. It's intended to be simple. The reason your unprefixed routes are inflecting is that your `/` scope uses `DashedRoute` when connecting the default routes.

Closing as the base Route class is working as it should and not being fancy :smile:

@markstory I think you might have misunderstood the issue. The problem is casing of values of `Controller::$name` and `Controller::$modelClass` changes depending on route class used. That shouldn't happen. Shouldn't the values of those properties always be CamelCased?
@ADmad Yes I did misunderstand the issue.

issue.title: Inflect Controller::$name when it is derived from request params.

repository.name: cakephp
repository.description: CakePHP: The Rapid Development Framework for PHP - Official Repository

issue.body:
When the controller name is derived from the request parameters we need to inflect the controller name. This ensures that view paths and convention based modelClass names are correct.

Refs #8081

issue.body:
This moves inflection into a more 'correct' place, but causes a bunch of other issues like breaking route symmetry between parse() and url().

I feel like the Controller location is less troublesome as the routing layer cares very little about the casing whereas the controller cares about its name being properly inflected.

:warning: I think this is a bad idea, but I wanted to discuss this and other options in this pull request.

Refs #8085
